transcript:
Maya: Let's review the website redesign. Sam, can you send the wireframes to the client by Friday?
Sam: Yes, I'll send them by Friday.
Maya: Great. Lena, please update the project budget sheet by October 28.
Lena: Will do.
Maya: I'll book the review call with the client for next Monday.

Raj: The checkout page crashes sometimes. Someone needs to look into it.
Tina: Yeah, and we need to rewrite the FAQ before the launch.
Raj: I'll prepare the launch checklist by October 30.
Tina: Let's also get quotes from vendors. Not sure who should handle that.

Chris: Quick sync. The server migration finished last week with no issues.
Dana: Great. Customer tickets are down 12 percent.
Chris: Good news all round. Nothing else from me.

Owen: For the conference, Priya will finalize the speaker list by November 2.
Priya: Yes. And Marco, please confirm the venue contract by tomorrow.
Marco: I'll do that. I'll also order the banners by November 6.
Owen: I'll send the invitations once the speaker list is final.

Ana: Ben, send the revised proposal to the board by Thursday.
Ben: Will do.
Ana: Carla, please share the survey results tomorrow.
Carla: Okay, tomorrow.
Ana: I'll send out the board meeting agenda by October 29.

Jo: We should update the onboarding guide soon. Mike, can you take it?
Mike: Sure, I'll get to it sometime next week.
Jo: And Kim will test the mobile app, probably before release.
Kim: Yes, I'll test it.
Jo: Also someone has to renew the SSL certificate. It expires on November 5.

Lee: Production is down for some users. Nadia, investigate the database errors immediately, this is critical.
Nadia: On it, I'll report back by 3 PM today.
Lee: Omar, prepare the incident report by Friday.
Omar: Okay.

Ravi: Morning all, how was the weekend?
Sita: Great, went hiking.
Ravi: Nice. Okay, onto business. Sita, can you draft the press release by October 27?
Sita: Sure. Also I'll need the product photos from Leo.
Leo: I'll upload the photos to the shared drive by October 26.
Ravi: Perfect. Let's also grab lunch Thursday, my treat.

Gina: Henry, you take the vendor payment report, due October 30.
Henry: I'm swamped. Can Iris take it instead?
Iris: Fine, I'll do the vendor payment report by October 30.
Gina: Henry, please then update the inventory sheet by October 22.

Zoe: We need to decide on the new CRM. Option A is cheaper, Option B has better support.
Eli: I vote for Option B.
Zoe: Agreed, we go with Option B. Eli, please email the vendor to start the contract by October 28.
Eli: Okay.
Zoe: Also, nobody touches the old CRM data until migration is finished.
